paragraphs: i'm maria, a creative from iași who never managed to pick just one thing.

i studied computer science, spent a few years building interfaces at deloitte, then followed the part of the job i liked most: the ideas. since then i've art-directed pharmacy campaigns at v8interactive, helped sell out every TEDxIași event, convinced a city to buy 3,000 rubber ducks in one week for a children's neuropsychiatry ward, and started a record label (fix media records) and a creative house (fixera media house).
i design, i edit video, i produce and mix music, and i organize the events where all of it gets used. what ties it together is simple: i like making things people actually show up for.
got a brief, a stage or a half-crazy idea? i'm probably in.
